sources.topic: Owner clauses on complete type declarations, self ownership, external PATH structure examples and no routine-local TYPE

contract.syntax: TYPE name FROM owner = complete supported definition
contract.standalone: Use declared layout with unverified external ownership; self-owned declarations are self-declared
contract.source_project: Before global allocation, validate same-named exported owner types by exact resolved schema; resolve self terminals and transitive reexports iteratively; reject missing sources/types, mismatches and cycles
contract.schema: Retain scalar behavior, bounded STRING capacity, fixed ARRAY dimensions and nominal names, ordered STRUCTURE fields, joint widths and supported resource schemas
contract.metadata: Program.imported_types and declared type_owners; report physical locations and source-validated terminal owners; Project.type_owners resolved metadata
contract.persistence: No runtime storage or archive schema change; ownership remains metadata alongside nominal names
contract.diagnostics: E_TYPE_LINK, E_TYPE_LINK_TYPE and E_TYPE_LINK_CYCLE at importer physical source location, including nested includes

boundaries: No binary environments, missing-definition imports, renamed imports or automatic source/library discovery
No owner-qualified native ABI; existing group annotations remain source metadata outside schema identity
No forward/self/cyclic type aliases, local TYPE extension, resource fields or weakened variable/routine/copy/FOR guards
Source reexport resolution is a Pythonic linker policy; strict and native/controller equivalence deferred
